instrument_scope.name: EU AI Act
instrument_scope.inventory_limitation: The public manifest proves the 417 identifiers, their frozen hashes and their aggregate root. It does not include the exact normalized source-text bytes needed to regenerate each per-provision hash, and no authority watcher was active when it was frozen.
instrument_scope.authority_watcher: NOT BUILT — local corpus only; no authority is polled

status_vocabulary.WIRED: At least one artifact names the provision AND the estate serves a live tool for it whose own artifact carries a counsel-confirmed obligation record or an executed measurement pane. This is tooling that exists today — it is not a claim that the provision is satisfied.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: The provision is named in estate artifacts and at least one served surface (register row, obligation record, informative crosswalk, probe record or card pack) touches it — but no counsel-confirmed obligation record and no executed measurement of the provision's own duty exists. Tracking, not measurement.
status_vocabulary.UNMEASURED: The provision exists in the estate ONLY as a frozen identifier and SHA-256 in the hash manifest. No published artifact names it, no tooling touches it. UNMEASURED is a first-class answer, not a failure to count.

truth_boundaries: 417 now resolves to 417 unique provision identifiers and SHA-256 content hashes, and the aggregate corpus root recomputes. The original SQLite database and exact historical source-text bytes were not recovered, so this is a frozen hash manifest, not a complete inspectable legal corpus.
The 17 adapters below are source-and-routing records. They do not confer regulator authority and they are not 17 live regulator APIs.
The 26 crosswalk assets are heterogeneous: measurement-derived statements, mappings, an example, a catalog, a producer and user-interface views. They are not 26 equivalent signed legal crosswalks.
The only public multi-jurisdiction crosswalk counted here maps four regimes in public/crosswalk/east-west-v1.json.
GSPC measurements are dated evidence, not certification, accreditation, legal advice or an authority's compliance decision.

Every label in this matrix is quoted or summarised from the estate artifacts listed in grounded_in; where no artifact names a provision, the label is null and the row is UNMEASURED. No article text has been added from outside this commit.
WIRED means tooling exists today; it never means the provision is satisfied. PARTIAL means tracked or mapped, not measured. UNMEASURED is a first-class answer.
The GPAI Code of Practice census is name-presence on a Commission page at retrieval time; it is not a legal list of signatories and is not a compliance judgement.
This matrix is generated by scripts/surface/build-gpai-matrix.mjs from this commit's artifacts; regenerate it rather than editing it.
